concerns.text: Dataset 'NOAA Buoy Data' (Qdrant/NOAA-Buoy) is a vector-search optimized embedding dataset, not a raw time-series source suitable for ADF/Hurst analysis. The plan requires raw values to compute stationarity and dependence metrics; using embeddings would invalidate the statistical tests. A raw NOAA source (e.g., direct CSV/NetCDF from NOAA NCEI) must be cited instead.

Dataset 'Daily Stocks' (chuyin0321/timeseries-daily-stocks) is a multi-asset parquet file. The plan requires '5+ distinct public continuous time series' for independent analysis. This single file contains thousands of series; the plan fails to specify which specific ticker(s) or how the selection is made to ensure independence and sufficient length (≥100 points) for Hurst estimation. A specific ticker or a filtered subset URL is required.

Dataset 'YouTube Trending' (jettisonthenet/timeseries_trending_youtube_videos_2019-04-15_to_2020-04-15) is a categorical event log (video views per day) with a fixed 1-year window. The plan requires 'continuous time series' to test robustness to non-independence in a general sense. This dataset is likely too short (365 points) to reliably estimate the Hurst exponent (which requires long-range dependence, typically N > 1000 for stable R/S analysis) and may not represent the 'long-range dependence' regime (H > 0.7) the study targets. A longer or more suitable social/traffic time series is needed.
